content.title: Wells Fargo’s Darrell Cronk: Stocks Will Rise in 2026, but It Will Be a Bumpy Ride
content.summary: Growth assets will continue their ascent this year, but investors should expect turbulence, says  Wells Fargo’s  Darrell Cronk.  “We think 2026 returns across most risk asset classes are going to be solid, in the upper single digits and lower double digits,” says Cronk, the chief investment officer of Wealth and Investment Management at Wells Fargo.  “But we don’t think the path is going to be smooth, which would be consistent with midterm election years.”
